{"consolidated_memory":"**Data loss in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt offline cache—three separate incidents**

All three incidents share: problem is data loss in offline cache (mobile sync side); reproduction involves force-stopping the app with unsynced edits; signal is a local row missing after the next launch. All work in the same corner of mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt with context carrying over between incidents.

**Incident 1: [2026-03-07] – Connection pool exhaustion**
- Trigger: first request after cold start with unsynced edits
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Result: job finished in 16 minutes instead of 1 hour (performance improvement)
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #3548 on branch fix/data-loss-1

**Incident 2: [2026-04-27] – Wrong environment file**
- Trigger: users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Result: 15 duplicate rows a day stopped being written (data integrity improvement)
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #3827 on branch fix/data-loss-2

**Incident 3: [2026-07-17] – N+1 query behind lazy relation**
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Result: memory settled at 331 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB (memory efficiency improvement)
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #6120 on branch fix/data-loss-3"}
